`testing.transitive_shipped_imports` walks a Modal app's shipped source and follows every import into another mounted package (resolving modules with `importlib.util.find_spec`, the same resolution the mount uses), reporting each import together with whether it names a mount-excluded file. Apps that mount a library with modules the image cannot support (the connector now ships `imbue.imbue_common` for its frozen-model base) use it to fail on the first shipped module that would reach such a module, instead of crashing at container import. The README documents the transitive rule and the namespace-package mount of a dotted subpackage.
